import asyncio

async def act(page):
    # Select source branch 'redesign' from the open listbox
    source_branch_option = page.get_by_role("listbox", name="Select source branch").get_by_role("option", name="redesign")
    await source_branch_option.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    
    # Now select target branch 'markdown-figure-block'
    # First, click the target branch button to open the listbox (assuming it's not open yet)
    target_branch_button = page.get_by_role("button", name="add-color-utility-classes")  # This might be the current target branch button
    await target_branch_button.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    # Wait for the listbox to appear and select 'markdown-figure-block'
    target_branch_option = page.get_by_role("listbox", name="Select target branch").get_by_role("option", name="markdown-figure-block")
    await target_branch_option.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    
    # Assign myself as reviewer
    # Look for a reviewer field; it might be a combobox or textbox with name containing 'Assign' or 'Reviewer'
    reviewer_field = page.get_by_role("combobox", name="Assign to", exact=False).or_(page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Assign to", exact=False))
    if await reviewer_field.count() > 0:
        await reviewer_field.click()
        await reviewer_field.fill("myself")  # Placeholder; in real scenario, use actual username
        # Optionally select from dropdown if appears
        await page.keyboard.press("Enter")
    else:
        # If not found, try alternative selectors
        reviewer_field_alt = page.get_by_role("combobox", name="Reviewer", exact=False).or_(page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Reviewer", exact=False))
        if await reviewer_field_alt.count() > 0:
            await reviewer_field_alt.click()
            await reviewer_field_alt.fill("myself")
            await page.keyboard.press("Enter")
        else:
            # If still not found, log a message but continue
            print("Reviewer field not found; proceeding without assignment.")
    
    # Submit the merge request
    submit_button = page.get_by_role("button", name="Submit merge request")
    await submit_button.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    
    # Check for success message
    success_indicator = page.get_by_text("Merge request created", exact=False)
    if await success_indicator.is_visible():
        return "Merge request submitted successfully."
    else:
        # If no success message, check for any confirmation
        confirmation = page.get_by_text("Merge request", exact=False)
        if await confirmation.is_visible():
            return "Merge request may have been created; verify manually."
        else:
            return "Merge request submission failed or status unclear."
